products.name: Gallery Consignment Intake
products.product: A focused art gallery consignment intake tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent commercial galleries and artist-run exhibition spaces
products.problem: Artwork identity, artist terms, price, condition, provenance documents, insurance value, location, and return terms are assembled across emails.
products.valueProposition: Turns art gallery consignment intake tracking into a visible operating queue so every accepted artwork has a complete consignment record, condition, custody location, and commercial terms.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets art gallery consignment intake tracking software, art gallery consignment intake tracking tracker, art gallery consignment intake tracking template, and art gallery consignment intake tracking checklist searches.
